newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fernz buys 11.25 pct of CFPI.
newsitem.headline: Fernz buys 11.25 pct of CFPI.

text.p: Fernz Corp said on Friday it had bought 11.25 percent of France's Compagnie Francaise des Produits Industriels for NZ$9.5 million.
CFPI is a chemical company with net assets of around 350 million francs (around NZ$100 million) and sales of 1.4 billion francs (NZ$390 million).
Claude Hess, president of the supervisory board, and family interests control more than 40 percent of the voting rights in the company.
Fernz said an application has been made to the appropriate French authorities and the Hess family to formalise a shareholding relationship in accordance with French law and practice.

Fernz said agricultural chemicals generate the bulk of CFPI's turnover and profit, and the company also manufactures industrial chemicals and fine chemicals for the pharmaceutical sector. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
